text: The tilted-box regression protects against false success and preserves conservative geometry. Requiring that this individual challenge case must physically succeed would introduce a stricter gate than the adopted 35-of-50 development target. That added requirement was removed. The case remains in the cohort with its actual outcome counted, and all previously validated physical-pass tests retain their success assertions. Sensor verification now allows the existing 0.10 s contact-loss guard to establish loss or recovery, within a finite verification budget; a recovered grip requires a fresh full 3 s window.
